atomic_cutover: Switch the only caller and remove the old provider in one deploy.
tests: Facade contract, RLS, rollback, and repository-failure tests.

runtime_evidence.workload: Describe affected flows, environment and observation window.
runtime_evidence.thresholds: Record applicable query budgets and acceptance criteria.
runtime_evidence.query_count: Record query counts per operation or explain non-applicability.
runtime_evidence.failure: Record failure-path results or explain non-applicability.
runtime_evidence.rollback: Record transaction rollback results or explain non-applicability.
runtime_evidence.smoke: Record affected flow smoke checks and results.

rollback_and_cleanup: Revert caller wiring; remove the old adapter after the observation window.
exit_criterion: All callers use one provider and the listed ratchet keys are absent.
